note: Financial blockers. Inherited MC-12 blockers are referenced and never silently removed or reclassified.

blockers.title: Chart and weather data-licence cost is UNKNOWN and the rights are NOT_GRANTED
blockers.impact: A material variable cost is missing, so NAV/WEATHER unit contribution and any subscription break-even are NOT_DETERMINABLE.
blockers.requiredEvidence: Executed licence terms with territory, caching, per-device and price conditions.

blockers.title: Conformity and certification programme cost is UNKNOWN
blockers.impact: Capex and financing requirement exclude a real, potentially material cost; the model carries an illustrative envelope only.

blockers.title: No supplier quotation, MOQ, lead time or payment term exists
blockers.impact: Inventory cash, working capital and hardware COGS rest on inherited assumptions and scenario terms.
blockers.requiredEvidence: Formal supplier quotations with MOQ, Incoterms and payment terms.

blockers.title: Product liability insurance premium is UNKNOWN
blockers.impact: A material fixed cost is excluded from EBITDA-like and break-even; the true operating break-even is higher.
blockers.requiredEvidence: Broker indication or quotation with territory and product scope.

blockers.title: CRA support-period engineering and update cost is UNKNOWN
blockers.impact: A multi-year recurring engineering cost is excluded from profitability and break-even.
blockers.requiredEvidence: Maintenance scope, support-period plan and cost rate.

blockers.title: No customer evidence, CAC, conversion, churn, renewal or willingness to pay
blockers.impact: Every demand profile and retention rate is an illustrative scenario assumption, not a forecast.
blockers.requiredEvidence: Executed interviews and pricing responses under AUTH-MC10-001.

blockers.title: EMBARCARTE current cash, funding and existing expenses are UNKNOWN
blockers.impact: The restricted current case cannot compute actual cash, burn or financing need; the model uses a zero opening-cash analysis convention only.
blockers.requiredEvidence: Company accounts, bank statement and written funding authorization.

blockers.title: EUR/USD exposure is not hedged and inherited BOM conversions use an engineering assumption
blockers.impact: A 10% FX movement changes hardware cost; no hedge or price-hold exists.
blockers.requiredEvidence: Supplier currency terms and a disclosed re-conversion pass (decision D-053).

blockers.title: Cross-border VAT/OSS and input-VAT treatment are not professionally confirmed
blockers.impact: VAT cash timing and net revenue conversion are modelled on a documented illustration, not tax advice.
blockers.requiredEvidence: Spanish tax adviser confirmation for each supply and channel.

blockers.title: FLEET onboarding, DPA, SLA and tenancy cost are not established
blockers.impact: FLEET unit contribution and break-even are conditional and exclude real onboarding and SLA cost.
blockers.requiredEvidence: Tenancy design, DPA, SLA and support-cost plan.

blockers.title: PILOT has no cost, revenue or safety case and cannot be modelled financially
blockers.impact: PILOT is excluded from every financial scenario; no zero-cost, zero-revenue fiction is produced.
blockers.requiredEvidence: PILOT safety case, hardware scope and quotation.

blockers.title: No inventory, credit, return or obsolescence agreement exists
blockers.impact: Inventory cash and stranded-stock exposure are scenario assumptions; downside stress shows the funding gap.
blockers.requiredEvidence: Supplier credit terms, return agreement and demand evidence.

blockers.title: No financing authorization, term sheet or investor commitment exists
blockers.impact: The analytical funding envelope is not an offer; the financing requirement is conditional and unfunded.
blockers.requiredEvidence: Written funding authorization or signed term sheet.

blockers.title: No price is approved
blockers.impact: Every price in the model is HYPOTHESIS_UNAPPROVED; no revenue figure is a forecast of realized price.
blockers.requiredEvidence: Approved price policy with channel, tax and WTP evidence.
